effect_description_eng: [On Play] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. Then, you may play 1 [Hina Kurihara] from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, if this Digimon has an [On Play] effect, gain 1 memory.
